name: White City Cubing 2017
information:
Registration will be closed at midnight on April, 19.
There is a limit of 100 competitors for this competition.
Spectators are welcome and do not need to register or pay. 
Registration fee:
* **100 RUB** for Rubik's Cube only;
* **250 RUB** for equal or less than 8 events; *(or 200 RUB using prepayment)*;
* **350 RUB** greater than 8 events. *(or 300 RUB using prepayment)*.

If you do not see your name on the compeitors table after 48 hours of registering, please [contact us](mailto:ruslan.chaika@mail.ru) to resolve the issue.

Visit the competition [website](https://vk.com/wcc2017) for more details.
